name: Adam "UNC1739" Crosser
biography: Adam Crosser is a Staff Security Engineer at Praetorian, specializing in offensive security research and tooling development. He began his career in red team operations, honing his skills in adversary simulation and advanced attack techniques. Now part of the Praetorian Labs team, Adam focuses on vulnerability research, exploit development, and building custom offensive security capabilities to support red team engagements—pushing the boundaries of adversary tradecraft.
